scenes.title: Your New Video
scenes.body: Edit this script in the GUI, or ask Claude to write it.
scenes.narration: Welcome to A I Video Creator. This is a starter video. Edit the script in the voiceover tab, or ask Claude in the CLI tab to write new scenes for you.

scenes.title: Add Your Scenes
scenes.body: Each scene has a title, a body line, and narration.
scenes.narration: Each scene has a title, a body line, and a line of narration. Pick a voice, generate the voiceover, and every scene resizes to fit its own audio automatically.

scenes.title: Render & Download
scenes.body: Export an MP4 from the Render tab.
scenes.narration: When you are happy, render your video to an M P 4 from the render tab, then download it. Happy creating!
